completed_repairs: Aggregate and review-packet receipts now remain externally non-authoritative behind receipt-specific fail-closed guards until the publisher completes its final checks.

Failed aggregate or review-packet publication leaves the fail-closed guard in place whenever rollback cannot prove canonical receipt withdrawal, including coordinated byte-identical replacement attacks.
Public aggregate and review-packet receipt verifiers reject guarded receipts before and after retained-closure validation.

Production pressure publication now proves that the running Python module and reviewed source members come from the read-only worker-extracted git archive HEAD snapshot, and rejects direct execution from the trusted checkout even when supplied a genuine archive.
new_decisions: Use a durable receipt-specific fail-closed guard as a negative publication authority. A receipt is externally consumable only when its guard is absent.
Arm the guard before canonical receipt rename and remove it only as the final successful publication action.
Leave the guard retained if rollback encounters a substituted canonical artifact so a byte-identical replacement receipt cannot remain accepted.
Bind pressure publication execution to a worker-extracted read-only git archive snapshot, not merely to possession of valid archive bytes.
first_required_human_input_after_automat: Select exactly one Section 5.4 problem/ps_p0 case from the verified immutable four-slice pressure-review packet.
